task.description: On branch feature/WF02-REQ058-20260818 (already checked out -- verify with git branch --show-current, STOP if not on it). Implement lib/letflow/design/req058-lua-script-audit.md exactly: the LuaScriptAudit Ecto schema, the migration (schema-per-tenant per REQ-022's :prefix convention -- follow the existing precedent migration the design cites), the Executor @behaviour, and Letflow.Engine.LuaScriptAudit.execute_script_for_audit/6 with the validated-before-invoke ordering, the manifest-hash-mismatch tagged error, and the moduledoc's verbatim-in-substance narrowness statement plus S5-deferred scope note. Do NOT add any Lua/NIF dependency to mix.exs. Run: mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix ecto.migrate against the test DB (or Docker fallback per docs/anti-patterns.md if no local toolchain), mix format --check-formatted. Run the Step 2a self-review checklist from WF-02 (no string interpolation of tenant/user input into raw SQL, no unresolved {:ok,_}= on external-I/O path, new public functions have @doc, all call sites still compile).
acceptance_criteria: priv/repo/migrations gains a lua_script_execution_audit migration, schema-per-tenant per REQ-022, applying cleanly against a provisioned tenant schema
execute_script_for_audit with a test-double executor writes exactly one audit row carrying instance_id, manifest_hash, actor_id and a timestamp, verified by reading the row back

the moduledoc carries R-Co's own narrowness statement in substance: this is not the SERVICE_TASK script-execution handler, must not be called from normal process-execution flow, and will be superseded (not extended) by the real scripting integration when it lands

no SQL string interpolation of tenant/user data
all callers of any changed function signature compile

result.summary:
Implemented per lib/letflow/design/req058-lua-script-audit.md exactly: Letflow.Engine.LuaScriptAudit (lib/letflow/engine/lua_script_audit.ex) with nested AuditRecord Ecto.Schema (id/instance_id/manifest_hash/actor_id/executed_at + timestamps, no tenant_id per Decision 0006 D2) and Executor @behaviour (one @callback execute_with_manifest/2, opaque script_ref type), plus execute_script_for_audit/6 with strict validate-instance_id-before-executor-invocation ordering and a distinct {:manifest_hash_mismatch, registered_hash, actual_hash} error. Migration priv/repo/migrations/20260820000011_create_lua_script_execution_audit.exs (schema-per-tenant `if prefix() do` guard, matching 20260818090001_create_promotion_assertion_runs.exs precedent) plus required lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex @tenant_scoped_migration_manifest registration (not in owned_modules but a hard AC1 prerequisite per design §0/§6.3). Moduledoc carries both required blocks verbatim-in-substance (narrowness statement: not the SERVICE_TASK handler, must not be called from normal process-execution flow, superseded not extended; S5-deferred scope note naming stage-5-scripting-plugins.md's build-vs-bind decision). mix.exs untouched -- no Lua/NIF dependency added (grep for lua/Lua/NIF/rustler/luerl in mix.exs returned no matches).

Verification commands and real output:
1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> 'Compiling 2 files (.ex)' / 'Generated letflow app', exit 0, zero warnings.
2. `mix format --check-formatted lib/letflow/engine/lua_script_audit.ex lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex priv/repo/migrations/20260820000011_create_lua_script_execution_audit.exs` -> no output (all three formatted; the repo-wide `mix format --check-formatted` shows unrelated pre-existing diffs in transition.ex/graph_test.exs/sandbox_pool_test.exs not touched by this change).
3. `MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=req058audit mix ecto.migrate` initially failed with `** (Ecto.MigrationError) migrations can't be executed, migration version 20260819000001 is duplicated` -- confirmed via `git stash` that this is a PRE-EXISTING bug on main (both priv/repo/migrations/20260819000001_create_groups_tenant_scoped.exs (PR #177) and priv/repo/migrations/20260819000001_drop_transition_events.exs (PR #199) already share this timestamp on main, unrelated to REQ-058, not in owned_modules -- flagged below rather than silently fixed). Worked around it for verification ONLY by temporarily moving 20260819000001_drop_transition_events.exs out of priv/repo/migrations/ (never committed, restored immediately after): `mix ecto.migrate` then ran clean through '== Migrated 20260820000011 in 0.0s', confirming this migration itself applies cleanly. File was moved back before continuing; `git status --short priv/repo/migrations/` after restore shows only the new migration as untracked, no residual diff.
4. End-to-end empirical verification via `mix run -e` against real Postgres (test DB, partition req058audit): inserted a real Tenant, called `TenantProvisioning.provision_tenant_schema/1` + `replay_migrations/1` (28 versions applied including 20260820000011), then exercised all three ACs with test-double Executor modules: AC2 -- `execute_script_for_audit/6` with a matching-hash double returned `{:ok, %AuditRecord{instance_id: ..., manifest_hash: "hash-abc", actor_id: ...}}`, independently read back via `Repo.get/3` with identical field values, `Repo.aggregate(:count)` == 1. AC3 -- called with `instance_id: nil` and `instance_id: "not-a-uuid"` against a call-recording double (`send(self(), :executor_called)`); both returned `{:error, :invalid_instance_id}` and `receive after 0` confirmed zero `:executor_called` messages (executor never invoked). AC4 -- a double returning `manifest_hash: "actual-hash"` against `registered_hash: "different-hash"` returned exactly `{:error, {:manifest_hash_mismatch, "different-hash", "actual-hash"}}` and row count stayed unchanged (no audit row written). Scratch DB dropped afterward (`mix ecto.drop`), `git status --short` clean of scratch artifacts.

Self-review checklist: no string interpolation of tenant/user input into raw SQL anywhere in the new files (migration uses only `prefix()`, no `#{}` inside SQL text; the one raw-SQL identifier interpolation project-wide, in tenant_provisioning.ex's CREATE SCHEMA, predates this change and is unmodified). No unresolved `{:ok, _} =` on an externally-reachable I/O path -- `executor.execute_with_manifest/2`'s and `Repo.insert/2`'s results are both fully `case`-matched with explicit error branches. Every new public function (`execute_script_for_audit/6`, `AuditRecord.insert_changeset/2`) carries a one-line-plus @doc. No existing function signature changed -- the only edit to an unowned file was a pure data-list append (tenant_provisioning.ex's @tenant_scoped_migration_manifest), not a signature change; `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` confirms every caller still compiles.

ISSUE FLAGGED, not fixed here (out of owned_modules, pre-existing on main before this branch): priv/repo/migrations/20260819000001_create_groups_tenant_scoped.exs and priv/repo/migrations/20260819000001_drop_transition_events.exs share the same version number 20260819000001, which makes any `mix ecto.migrate` against a fresh/from-scratch DB fail with Ecto.MigrationError regardless of this REQ-058 change. Reproduced identically with this branch's own changes stashed. Needs its own fix (renumbering one of the two, matching the migration-numbering-collision class docs/anti-patterns.md already documents) by whichever agent owns that -- routing this to ORCH/REVIEWER alongside this handoff rather than silently renumbering an unowned, already-merged pair of migrations myself.
